services.desc: Where do your musky fishing charters take place?Capital Musky primarily guides musky fishing trips on the Ottawa River, with additional early-season opportunities on the Rideau River and other surrounding water bodies. Launch locations-including Rockland, ON and other lower Ottawa River access points-are selected shortly before your trip based on weather, water conditions, and guest convenience to maximize success. Do I need prior musky fishing experience?No experience is required. Capital Musky welcomes beginners, intermediate anglers, and experienced musky fishermen.
